hooks.name: Spec traceability check
hooks.description: When a spec's requirements change, ask the agent to re-check that design and tasks still trace to every acceptance criterion.

action.prompt: requirements.md changed. List any acceptance criteria not referenced by a task in the same spec's tasks.md, and any task referencing a criterion that no longer exists. Propose the minimal edits to design.md and tasks.md; do not change code.
